newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Xomed EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Xomed EPS view cut.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Samuel Navarro said he cut his earnings forecasts on Xomed Surgical Products Inc but maintained his buy rating on the stock.
-- Navarro said he cut the 1996 forecast to $0.55 a share from $0.60. The 1977 estimate was trimmed to $0.80 a share from $0.98, and the 1998 estimate was cut to $1.20 from $1.35.

-- Navarro cited a slowdown in the ear surgery market. While the market comprises only about 20 percent of Xomed's annual revenues, the sector generates very high margins, and any shortfall in this area would hurt earnings, he said.

-- Navarro said another reason for trimming his 1996 estimate was a distribution strategy change in Germany and Japan that will help Xomed's long-term profits but which reduced fourth quarter revenues by about $500,000.
-- Xomed's stock was off 6-1/4 to 13 in morning trading.
